recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞質充滿粗大橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes），分布於正常成熟的顆粒球系與紅血球系之間，無明顯芽細胞增加，符合嗜酸性球增多。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei, showing full maturation
Some immature eosinophilic cells with admixed darker basophilic-staining granules
Background of maturing neutrophilic and erythroid cells
No sheets of blasts in this field; fat vacuoles present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors at all stages of maturation, characterized by abundant coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules. Neutrophilic and erythroid maturation is present in the background, and blasts are not increased in this field. No overt dysplasia is evident at this magnification. Findings represent eosinophilia with orderly maturation, compatible with reactive eosinophilia; exclusion of a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia (e.g., PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement) depends on clinical correlation and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: It may look identical morphologically and is identified by FISH/molecular detection of FIP1L1::PDGFRA, often with increased atypical mast cells.
inv(16) AML shows increased blasts with abnormal eosinophils containing large purple-violet basophilic granules, rather than orderly eosinophilic maturation.
CML shows basophilia with a myelocyte bulge and BCR::ABL1, rather than isolated eosinophilia.
